body:
Three changes to agent briefs, so tech debt is filed or fixed instead of lost, and investigations hand over checkable work.

### 1. Review: non-blocking items go to Tech debt

A review puts every non-blocking item in its `### Tech debt` section, never under Findings, so completing the task files it on a Tech Debt task.

Example: the review of task:3d346fcd77e0cede wrote a `### Findings (non-blocking)` section. Items there are not filed when the task completes.

- In the review brief (`board::briefs.review_role`, `TECH_DEBT_ASK`, `review_context`), say plainly that Findings hold only what explains the assessment or blocks this task, and that any item to fix later goes in `### Tech debt`, nowhere else.
- Remove the wording that lets a non-blocking item go "in the findings or tech debt" (`review_context`).

### 2. Worker sent back after a review fixes its tech debt

When a task goes back to a worker after a review, the worker fixes the review's findings and its `### Tech debt` items that fall within the task's scope, even when the review said Looks good, without the human having to ask in a note. It names in its summary any item it left, and why.

- Change the work brief (`board::briefs.work_role`) to say so.

### 3. Investigation: checkable criteria, risks settled

- The report gives clear acceptance criteria: each one a check a worker or reviewer can confirm.
- The investigator settles any risk it can resolve itself (by reading, checking or making the call) instead of leaving it open. It lists a risk only when it can't settle it, and says why.
- Change the investigation brief (`board::briefs.investigation_role`) to say so.

### Acceptance

- Brief tests check that each of the three briefs carries its new rule, and that the review brief no longer offers Findings as a place for non-blocking items.

### Left out

Rejecting or rewriting notes that break these rules; filed Tech Debt tasks from other tasks.
title: briefs: tech debt and investigation reports
